integrity: The proof derives barycentric facet equations directly from the Moore--Penrose pseudoinverse, uses graph automorphism transitivity to equalize facet-normal lengths, uses the pseudoinverse spectral trace for the exact inradius, and proves both radius optima and center uniqueness by sharp averaging/summing arguments. Finite exact replay on four graph families is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the canonical full-Laplacian Euclidean realization of a connected vertex-transitive simple graph. Euclidean radii are not preserved by the non-orthogonal unimodular coordinate changes used to choose lattice representatives. Vertex transitivity is sufficient but not claimed necessary, and no John or Loewner ellipsoid statement is made.
title: Vertex-transitive Laplacian simplices have spectral inradii and degree-controlled circumradii
